Subject: Mutual Success Plan: Kramer Biotech MAP kickoff and proposed weekly cadence

Hi Emma / Jack —

Good to meet you on the demo last week. Per our discussion, I’m proposing a short, structured Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and weekly checkpoint cadence to get Kramer through evaluation to contract signature in a predictable 8–10 week window. Goal here is alignment on stakeholders, concrete success criteria, owners, and what we’ll measure at each checkpoint.

High-level proposal:
- Cadence: 30-minute weekly checkpoints (Tuesdays, 30 min) for focused progress updates and unblockers
- Primary success criteria: 1) end-to-end latency < 350ms p50 on representative traffic, 2) inference cost estimate within agreed target range, 3) model output quality (ROUGE/BLEU or customer eval rubric) passes baseline thresholds, 4) security/compliance evidence delivered
- First 2 weeks: onboarding + evaluation baseline tests; Weeks 3–6: perf/scale runs and integration; Weeks 7–8: contract/ops alignment and final decision

Immediate asks (can we confirm before our first checkpoint?):
1) Please confirm the primary evaluation owner on your side (name + email).
2) Share a short sample of the evaluation prompts/expected outputs (sensitive redaction OK) by EOD Wed 1/7 so Marcus can scope test harness.
3) Legal: can Kramer share SOC2/HIPAA requirements doc or confirm which evidence you will need? We can loop legal later this week.

I’ve attached a one-page MAP spreadsheet (Kramer_MUTUAL_SUCCESS_PLAN_v1.xlsx) and our security brief (redwood_security_brief.pdf). I’ll draft a calendar invite for a recurring Tuesday slot — propose Tue 1/13 at 10:00 AM PT for the first checkpoint unless you prefer another time.

Owner assignments (initial):
- Redwood exec sponsor: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — overall program owner
- Redwood SE (evaluation & perf): Marcus Lin — test harness and perf runs
- Redwood CS (onboarding & ops): Monica Patel — integration checklist, runbooks
- Kramer evaluation owner: (TBD — please confirm)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Quick answers:
- Kramer evaluation owner will be me (Emma Kramer) — I’ll own coordinating the internal test data and stakeholders.

Appreciate the clear owners — looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks — looping in a few evaluation details so we’re ready for 1/13: 

Planned evaluation steps (high level):
1) Baseline run: run representative prompts against the selected open model variant to capture latency and output quality (owner: Marcus) — needs sample prompts by 1/7
2) Integration smoke test: customer to validate request/response flow (owner: Emma) — target 1/13
3) Scale perf runs: synthetic load to simulate 100–500 qps for throughput and cost estimates (owner: Marcus) — target weeks 3–4
4) Quality sweep: customer eval rubric + manual spot-checks (owner: Emma + Monica) — ongoing weeks 2–5

Deliverables for the first checkpoint (1/13):
- Baseline latency report (p50/p95), test harness config, and example curl/postman payloads (Marcus)
- Integration checklist + onboarding runbook (Monica)
- Customer sample prompts and target quality rubric (Emma)

Notes on infra: recommended starting profile — 1x 80GB GPU instance with quantized model variant for latency testing; we’ll propose alternative configs after baseline. I’ll add a short tech appendix to the MAP spreadsheet outlining expected instance profiles.

-Marcus
